$comment: HZ-133: the contract for domain/personas.json. Validated by domain/validate.mjs — the same dependency-free Draft-07 subset validator the other domain/ schemas use, so only the keywords listed in its KEYWORDS set are honoured (no `pattern`, no schema-valued `additionalProperties`). Rules the subset cannot express — the id shape ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ on agents and persona ids, unique agents, ids unique WITHIN their agent, `default` being one of its own agent's personas, (HZ-381) `roleFiles` keyed by exactly its own agent's personas with every value a role file matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.md$ and no value shared by two personas, `primaryAgent` naming a declared agent, every legacyIds value and personaProviders key naming a live <agent>.<persona> pair, and (HZ-192) every models value being a Claude model id matching ^claude-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*$, models.agents keys having the id shape, models.conflictAgent naming a models.agents key, and every models.personas key naming a live pair that personaProviders does NOT route elsewhere — are asserted at LOAD time by the bindings themselves: see assertPersonasShape() in domain/js/personas.js and _validate_source() in domain/py/personas.py, which domain/fixtures/personas-cases.json drives from both sides so the two cannot drift. `additionalProperties: false` at every object level is what keeps presentation (labels, initials, colours) structurally out of this file rather than out by convention.
title: Horizon specialist personas: ids, agent membership, defaults, persona-to-provider and the model each agent call uses

primaryAgent.$comment: The agent whose persona the PM proposes at intake and the board/tracker show as an item's primary specialization. Must name a declared agent — asserted at load time.

agents.$comment: ARRAY ORDER IS THE ORDER. It is the picker's group order and the farm's provider_for() scan order, so it is visible behaviour. Each persona id is unique only WITHIN its agent (HZ-125): `python` under eng and a future `python` under qa are different personas.

agent.$comment: A persona-agent key (lower-case), not a domain/steps.json agent name.

default.$comment: The persona an item gets for this agent when it carries none, or carries one that does not belong to this agent. Must be one of this entry's `personas` — asserted at load time.

personas.$comment: ARRAY ORDER IS THE ORDER the picker lists them in.

roleFiles.$comment: HZ-381: persona id -> its role markdown filename in farm/roles/personas/. Keys must equal this entry's `personas` exactly, every value must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.md$ (no slash, no dot-dot — asserted at load time), and no two personas may share a file.

legacyIds.$comment: Flat pre-HZ-125 work_item.persona value -> the namespaced "<agent>.<persona>" it now means. Read-only compatibility for old rows, never written. Each value must name a declared pair — asserted at load time.

personaProviders.$comment: Namespaced "<agent>.<persona>" -> the farm provider that persona forces. Ships EMPTY (HZ-121): no shipped persona forces a provider. Keys must name a declared pair — asserted at load time.

models.$comment: HZ-192: the ONE place a farm call's Claude model is chosen. farm/agent_runner.py resolves every run_agent() call through resolve_model(): models.personas["<agent>.<persona>"], then models.steps[<step label>], then models.agents[<agent>]. A lifecycle step's model agent is its domain/steps.json `agent` lower-cased (so those display names are a contract); the concierge is agent `concierge`; conflict resolution is agent `conflictAgent` with step key `conflict`. Never reaches a non-Claude provider: run_agent() passes no model to Muse.

agents.$comment: Model agent -> its default Claude model id. Must carry every lower-cased domain/steps.json agent plus `concierge` (farm/tests/test_models_domain.py).

conflictAgent.$comment: The models.agents key merge-conflict resolution (farm/conflict_resolver.py) runs as. Data, not code, so neither binding inlines an agent name.

steps.$comment: Exact domain/steps.json agent-step label (or the reserved key `conflict`) -> a Claude model id overriding the agent default for that step. Ships empty.

personas.$comment: Namespaced "<agent>.<persona>" -> a Claude model id overriding step and agent. Ships empty. A key personaProviders routes to another provider is rejected at load time.
